    \caption{Top-1 accuracy (\%) of the gated duos against the static duo, in each way of adapting. Large / small: ViT-B/16 / ResNet-50 (V1), adapted with TENT, severity 5. Vanilla DD and Joint DD weight the members with $w_L = \sigma(\beta (s_L - s_S))$, $s$ the logit of the nnn proxy (identity calibration, no temporal filter) computed on proxy batches of 256 samples, $\beta = 0.5$, and pool the logits as $w_L z_L / T_L + w_S z_S / T_S$ with $w_S = 1 - w_L$. In Vanilla DD the gate sits outside the adaptation loop (the members adapt on their own entropy and never see it); in Joint DD it sits inside, and both members adapt on the entropy of the gated prediction. The static duo is $(z_L / T_L + z_S / T_S) / 2$ with $T_L = 0.82$, $T_S = 1.04$, fitted on the four held-out corruptions pooled, and the gates use the same $T_L$, $T_S$. Any model that does not adapt is frozen: it keeps its weights and uses the test batch's normalization statistics. Hyperparameters of the adapting models: batch size 64. The optimizer depends on the entropy the models minimize. Models that adapt on their own entropy: ViT-B/16: SGD (learning rate $5 \times 10^{-5}$, momentum 0.9, dampening 0, weight decay 0, no Nesterov). ResNet-50 (V1): SGD (learning rate $2.5 \times 10^{-4}$, momentum 0.9, dampening 0, weight decay 0, no Nesterov). Models that adapt on the duo entropy: ViT-B/16: SGD (learning rate $3.2 \times 10^{-3}$, momentum 0.9, dampening 0, weight decay 0, no Nesterov). ResNet-50 (V1): SGD (learning rate $4 \times 10^{-3}$, momentum 0.9, dampening 0, weight decay 0, no Nesterov). With one model adapting on the duo entropy, it uses its optimizer from this list. The own-entropy rows (Independent, Vanilla DD) use the first set of learning rates, the duo-entropy rows (Joint, Joint DD) the second. \emph{Clean}: the ImageNet validation images, not part of Avg., the mean over the 15 corruptions. Mean over 3 seeds.}
